title: Out-of-bounds write possible in Git when git-merge(1) used on tag with more than two GPG signatures (CVE-2026-114467)
description: A low-severity out-of-bounds write vulnerability exists in Git when the git-merge command is used on a tag containing more than two GPG signatures. This flaw could potentially cause a denial of service or application instability but does not impact confidentiality or integrity.
